text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: (I see. So this is what a race is...)

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Haaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
(It really is different from a mock race. 
The sheer intensity to snatch victory 
comes crashing right into me.)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: However! It's not enough!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa... Gentildonna... I'd heard the 
rumors, but...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
To look this polished in a Make Debut...! 
She's an absolute monster...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Hohoho...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Another absolute monster has appeared! 
—Following right after last year!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Gentildonna will *also* go for 
the Classic Triple Crown~?

Gentildonna successfully completed her 
Make Debut. When I asked her thoughts upon 
her return—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: My conviction has only deepened.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
A race... This very stage! It is truly 
worthy of demonstrating my power.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The leg strength to kick up the turf. The 
intellect to view the race from above and 
plan ahead.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
In a race, you must sharpen all of that— 
and clash with the true essence of your 
power to win.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Truly delightful. I look forward to 
competing at an even higher level.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes. For example—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"How would you feel... about facing the 
one who's currently the talk of the town?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown... Pardon me. 
You're "still" just a Double Crown 
Umamusume, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The winner is Orfevre!! A Double Crown 
Umamusume is born...!!!!

"That Umamusume's name is Orfevre. Having 
won the Satsuki Sho and the Tokyo Yushun 
(Japanese Derby), she leads this year's 
Classic Triple Crown route."

Especially at the recent Japanese Derby, 
she broke through from an unfavorable 
position to seize victory, showing off her 
overwhelming strength.
choice_data_list:
(Still, there's another reason she's the 
talk of the town...)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hey. You over there.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fan
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Ah, um, me...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hand it over. ...That's the one.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you mean... my—... Ah! Y-Yes, of 
course!! Please... feel free to use it~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
—Aaaah!? Wiping the mud off her face with 
a fan's shirt...?!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ah! And they just tossed it away...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Orfevre... is seriously unreal after all!

She has also made headlines for her 
outrageous behavior, such as ditching 
interviews and press conferences at the 
last minute. The unprecedented Double 
Crown Umamusume... Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Her ability is on an entirely different 
level.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
She will surely win the Kikuka-sho as 
well. And then, become a Classic Triple 
Crown Umamusume.

The Classic Triple Crown... That is a 
historic achievement that only six 
Umamusume have ever accomplished.
choice_data_list:
You really believe in Orfevre's strength, 
huh

You believe in Orfevre's strength, don't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I am sure you are all well aware of her 
strength. It stands as an objective fact.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Or rather, I need you to accomplish it. 
—For my sake."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Either way, that's far off in the future. 
For now, let's just—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I must go and claim my Tiara.

Returning to the academy, I meet with 
Gentildonna to discuss our next plan of 
action. Heading toward the great goal of 
the Tiara route—
choice_data_list:
Let's enter a race that leads to the Tiara 
route

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ... For instance?

With Gentildonna's level of ability, a 
Junior-tier GⅠ race like the Hanshin 
Juvenile Fillies should be...

I propose several major races to 
Gentildonna. All of them are graded stakes 
that lead up to the Classic class.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It's quite a shame, but you're not even 
worth discussing.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The Shinzan Kinen. Please proceed with the 
registration for that race.

The Shinzan Kinen... A G3 race held at 
Kyoto Racecourse. Umamusume with all kinds 
of goals participate in this race.

Of course, there are Umamusume aiming for 
the Tiara route... but far more girls set 
their sights on the Classic Triple Crown 
route.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Shall we call it... the preparation before 
the Tiara?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If we win that race decisively, we will be 
able to open everyone's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because everyone seems to be 
misunderstanding.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Gentildonna will *also* go for 
the Classic Triple Crown~?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
What's important isn't which race you win. 
It's how you win. And yet... everyone 
centers their thinking around the race 
itself.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That is why I'm going to slap your cheek 
for you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—With the strength to defeat anyone. Do 
that, and the noise about your path will 
fade away.
choice_data_list:
So the path you walk is the path of 
supremacy... huh.

So the path you walk is the path of 
supremacy... huh.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Could you please look at things from a 
broader, higher perspective? If you truly 
are my Trainer, that is."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Do keep up the good work. Have a wonderful 
day.

"Her back as she walks away overlaps with 
that same back that left me behind in the 
past... I know my own inexperience. But 
without fail――"
choice_data_list:
(Next time, I'll make Gentil acknowledge 
me...!)

text_block_list.text:
For our next target race... the Shinzan 
Kinen, the first race of the Classic year, 
I will prove my own worth alongside hers.
